snippet.title: Fresh Tracks VR Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
That's right, Fresh Tracks is coming to VR! Leave us a wishlist and keep an eye on our channel for updates on the release date: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200240/Fresh_Tracks_VR/
.
Get the flat screen game on Steam and get the VR support for free on launch!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202950/Fresh_Tracks/
